_comment: Family accounts for Plex and Jellyfin, managed by ./configure.sh. Copy to users.json (gitignored: it names
your family) and edit. One object per user; this first object is documentation and is ignored.
name       the Jellyfin user name (created when missing, without a password)
role       admin | adult | child. admin: every right. adult: every library, but may not
delete media or control other people's players. child: as adult, plus a parental
rating, unrated items blocked, no SyncPlay, and no music library.
born       a child's date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Preferred over `rating`: the rating is
recomputed on every run as the Kijkwijzer step they have reached, so it
moves on its own. A number written once goes stale in silence - a child
given 9 still has 9 on their twelfth birthday and nobody notices until
they ask why something is missing. Steps: under 6 is 0 (AL), then 6, 9,
rating     a fixed content rating, overriding `born` when both are set - an explicit
number is someone overruling the ladder on purpose. Same scale as above,
on the metadata country (PLEX_CERTIFICATION_COUNTRY=NL is Kijkwijzer). It
is a rating, not an age: a five-year-old is 0. Ratings from other systems
are mapped onto it (PG-13 is 13, R is 17), and an unrated item is blocked
for a child whatever the number says.
music      give a child the music library back (default false). Music is withheld from
children by library rather than by rating, because tracks carry no age
rating at all - so no rating can grant it and this is the only way. For an
older child who should have it while still being held to a film rating.
channels   may open plugin channels, when a plugin that publishes any is installed (default false)
hidden     not shown on the login screen                       (default false)
nopass     signs in without a password; one set in the UI is removed again (default false;
not possible for an admin, Jellyfin refuses it)
rich       backdrops, theme media, details banner, next-episode overlay, episode stills,
Collections view, set on every run                   (default false)
audio      preferred audio language, ISO 639-2 (nld, eng): that track plays when present
subtitles  preferred subtitle language; when set, subtitles are always shown
Rights and preferences are re-applied on every run, so edit them here, not in the UI.
Users that exist in Jellyfin but not here are left alone, never deleted.
